description: This file implements a custom BatchSampler class for benchmarking purposes, comparing its performance against the standard BatchSampler in PyTorch. It includes a main function that runs performance benchmarks with various batch sizes and drop_last options, measuring execution time and calculating speedup percentages.

classes.name: NewBatchSampler
classes.description: An alternative implementation of PyTorch's BatchSampler for benchmarking, supporting iteration over batches with configurable drop_last behavior.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the NewBatchSampler with a sampler, batch size, and drop_last flag, with input validation.

methods.name: __iter__
methods.description: Provides an iterator over batches of indices, handling drop_last behavior.

methods.name: __len__
methods.description: Returns the number of batches, based on the sampler length and batch size.
